
Various zero-modified exponential distributions are shown in the visualisation below, for different values of\ $\lambda$ and\ $p$.



```{r, ZMEDemo, echo=FALSE, fig.align="center", fig.cap="Zero-modified exponential distributions."}
library(plotly)

###  Parameters  ###
ps      <- c(0.3, 0.6, 0.9)
lambdas <- c(0.5, 2)
x_vals  <- c(0, seq(0.01, 10, 
                    length.out = 500) )

fig <- plot_ly(width = 650, 
               height = 450)

###  Traces  ###
counter <- 1
for (LAMBDA in lambdas) {
  for (P in ps) {
    p0   <- P
    dens <- (1 - P) * dexp(x_vals, rate = LAMBDA)

    fig <- fig %>% add_trace(
      x = 0, 
      y = p0,
      type = "scatter", 
      mode = "markers",
      marker = list(size = 12, 
                    color = "steelblue"),
      visible = (counter == 1),
      name = paste0("P(X=0) = ", round(p0, 2))
    )
    fig <- fig %>% add_trace(
      x = x_vals, 
      y = dens,
      type = "scatter", 
      mode = "lines",
      line = list(width = 2, 
                  color = "steelblue"),
      visible = (counter == 1),
      showlegend = FALSE
    )
    counter <- counter + 2
  }
}

total_traces <- counter - 1

### Build flat button list in loop order (lambda outer, p inner)  ###
buttons <- list()
btn_idx <- 1
for (li in seq_along(lambdas)) {
  for (pi in seq_along(ps)) {
    LAMBDA <- lambdas[li]
    P      <- ps[pi]
    tidx   <- (li - 1) * length(ps) * 2 + (pi - 1) * 2 + 1
    vis    <- rep(FALSE, 
                  total_traces)
    vis[c(tidx, tidx + 1)] <- TRUE

    buttons[[btn_idx]] <- list(
      method = "update",
      args   = list(
        list(visible = as.list(vis)),
        list(
          title = paste0("Zero-modified exponential:  p = ", P, ", \u03bb = ", LAMBDA),
          annotations = list(
            list(
              x = 0.95, 
              y = 0.95,
              xref = "paper", 
              yref = "paper",
              text = paste0("P(X = 0) = ", round(P, 2),
                            "<br>P(X > 0) = ", 1 - P),
              showarrow = FALSE,
              xanchor = "right", 
              yanchor = "top",
              font = list(size = 12, 
                          color = "black")
            )
          )
        )
      ),
      label = paste0("p=", P, ", \u03bb=", LAMBDA)
    )
    btn_idx <- btn_idx + 1
  }
}


###  Top row = lambda=0.5 (buttons 1,2,3), bottom row = lambda=2 (buttons 4,5,6)  ###
top_row_buttons    <- buttons[1:3]
bottom_row_buttons <- buttons[4:6]


###  Plots  ###
fig <- fig %>%
  layout(
    title = list(text = "Zero-modified exponential distribution", x = 0.5),
    xaxis = list(title = "x", range = c(-0.2, 10)),
    yaxis = list(title = "Density / P(X = 0)", range = c(0, 1.05)),
    margin = list(t = 50, b = 120),
    updatemenus = list(
      list(
        type      = "buttons",
        direction = "right",
        x         = 0,
        y         = -0.18,
        xanchor   = "left",
        yanchor   = "top",
        buttons   = top_row_buttons
      ),
      list(
        type      = "buttons",
        direction = "right",
        x         = 0,
        y         = -0.30,
        xanchor   = "left",
        yanchor   = "top",
        buttons   = bottom_row_buttons
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  config(displayModeBar = FALSE)

fig
```
